notes.title: Selected for Indie Live Expo 04/13!!
notes.notes:
Abyss Ring has been selected as one of the featured titles of “Indie Wave” at Indie Live Expo 04/13, the largest online indie game showcase event in Asia.

This will be one of the largest online indie game introduction events in Asia, which has been translated and viewed in many countries including Japan, Korea, and Greater China.

The event is scheduled to begin airing on April 13 at 7:00 p.m.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/live/04nJf4BeoUg]YouTube Indie Live Expo 2025.4.13[/url]
